note: Local servers that expose an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions accepting base64 image_url. Select with VISION_RUNTIME=<id>; VISION_ENDPOINT overrides the URL (other host/port). disable_thinking = extra top-level request fields sent ONLY for models whose preset says they think; null = no documented per-request switch (the client then raises the token budget and strips <think> from replies). Rows marked unverified were not confirmed in the runtime's docs.

runtimes.name: llama-swap (in front of llama.cpp)
runtimes.model_id: the model key/alias in your llama-swap config.yaml
runtimes.notes: The original default of this skill (port 8081 on the author's box; llama-swap's own default is 8080). Passes the body through to llama-server.

runtimes.name: llama.cpp llama-server
runtimes.model_id: ignored by a single-model server (any string works); use --alias to name it
runtimes.notes: Start with -m model.gguf --mmproj mmproj.gguf (or -hf repo, which fetches the mmproj). Reasoning, when split, arrives in message.reasoning_content.

runtimes.name: Ollama
runtimes.model_id: name:tag as in `ollama list`, e.g. qwen2.5vl:7b
runtimes.notes: OpenAI-compatible endpoint accepts base64 data URIs only. reasoning_effort:none on vision models unverified; replies are still stripped of <think> and retried with a bigger budget if needed.

runtimes.name: vLLM
runtimes.notes: Reasoning is split into message.reasoning only with --reasoning-parser; otherwise <think> stays in content (stripped client-side).

runtimes.name: SGLang
runtimes.notes: Base64 image_url unverified in docs (standard OpenAI format).

runtimes.name: LM Studio
runtimes.notes: No documented per-request thinking switch; Qwen3-family presets append /no_think on retry.

runtimes.name: MLX-VLM server (Apple silicon)
runtimes.notes: python -m mlx_vlm.server --port 8080. enable_thinking is a top-level field here. Base64 image_url unverified.

runtimes.name: LocalAI
runtimes.model_id: the model name from its YAML config / gallery
runtimes.notes: mmproj is configured in the model YAML. Base64 and a thinking switch unverified.

runtimes.name: Jan
runtimes.model_id: the model id shown in Jan (unknown id -> 404)
runtimes.notes: Optional bearer key (VISION_API_KEY). Vision support depends on the loaded model; unverified.

runtimes.name: KoboldCpp
runtimes.notes: Start with --mmproj; --visionmaxres caps image size. Base64 image_url expected, unverified.
